_note: PRE-REGISTERED scoring rubric for the HARDENED Test C. Written 2026-06-06 BEFORE the count-enumeration agents run. I convert each sector's blind-enumerated rating-action counts into an ordinal stress score via this fixed rule; agents do NOT see this file or assign scores.

ordinal_stress_rubric_0to3.3: defaults / payment-interruptions / Chapter 11 / DSRF draws > 0, OR a sector-wide MULTI-notch (>=3) downgrade
ordinal_stress_rubric_0to3.2: multiple distinct issuers downgraded AND/OR negative sector outlook with downgrades, no defaults
ordinal_stress_rubric_0to3.1: isolated/minor downgrade or negative outlook only; mostly held
ordinal_stress_rubric_0to3.0: net affirmations or upgrades; no downgrades, no defaults

scoring: rank the 8 sectors within each crisis by ordinal stress (3=most stressed); TIES allowed and expected in the middle; break ties by (deepest notch downgraded, then default count). Compute tie-aware Spearman rho vs the sealed beta-rank prediction.
robust_secondary_metric: 3-bucket hit rate. Predicted buckets by beta: HIGH={State GO, County COP, TAB} (beta>=0.18); MED={Hospital, CCRC, CalHFA} (beta 0.09-0.17); LOW={School GO, Water} (beta 0.03). Actual bucket from ordinal stress: HIGH=score 3, MED=score 1-2, LOW=score 0. Report agreement.
